description: ACT Government Bike & Ride Locations is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by ACT Government Open Data. This dataset outlines the location and details of bike & ride facilities within the ACT. These facilities enable users to use both cycling and public transport modes of travel. Further details on the types of bike and ride locations are available on the Transport Canberra website provided in the metadata. Coverage: ACT Government Open Data. The portal files it under the publisher ACT Government Open Data. Its tags are bike, bike-and-ride, bikeshare. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON, KML, KMZ. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
